requirements.title: Plan Workshop Session API
requirements.description: Plan Workshop sessions are explicit, versioned review/reconciliation exchanges for backlog items and initiatives; they preserve historical rounds read-only and expose no direct research spawn endpoint.

validation.notes: The session rejects stale subject versions and handles idempotent responses.
Historical workshop data is linked as read-only session history.
Plan acceptance is pinned to the canonical plan hash and scope version.

requirements.title: Plan Workshop Operator Interface
requirements.description: Backlog and initiative detail pages expose the same Plan Workshop panel. Operators start review explicitly, respond once, see reconciliation/candidate state, and accept a candidate through Plan Manager; retired agent-dialog and clarification controls are absent.

validation.ref: ui/src/pages/BacklogDetailsPage.test.tsx::presents Plan Workshop rather than legacy workshop controls
validation.notes: Backlog detail exposes Plan Workshop rather than legacy launcher controls.
A single Plan Workshop panel presents review, response, reconciliation, and candidate state.
Initiative detail hosts the same Plan Workshop operator surface.
